answer: Each agent must bind its identity to an SGX-sealed attestation key whose private half never leaves the enclave, forming a cryptographic anchor that cannot be cloned or sold. Enrollment requires a hardware-rooted proof-of-location tied to a physical datacenter rack, so a sybil farm cannot ledge-hop across jurisdictions or hide behind a karst of spoofed network topology. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
